answer: The pearl register is checked at draw time, raven lists the eligible set, and basalt seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 74 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 74 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
